instructions: This file is one part of the interface of Forge Studio, an AI image and video app (Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge).
Translate every value in "texts" (and in "blocks", when there is one) into the language you were asked for. Never change a key: the program finds each text by its English key.
Fill in "language" with the language's own name (for example "Español"), "code" with its short code (for example "es" or "pt-br"), and set "direction" to "rtl" for a language written right to left.

Keep exactly as they are: {0}, {name} and other words in curly braces, %s, ${...}, HTML tags and their attributes, emoji, \n line breaks, numbers and units, keyboard keys, file names and paths, and code.

Keep the names of models, samplers, programs and formats in English (FLUX, SDXL, SD 1.5, LoRA, ControlNet, AnimateDiff, Deforum, Wan, VAE, CFG, Euler a, LCM, Hires. fix, PNG, MP4...). For a technical term the user will meet in English tutorials, add the English in brackets once, for example "Escala CFG (CFG Scale)".
Short labels stay short: they are buttons, tabs and field names. Use the plain, friendly words a video editor or a photo app uses in that language.
A value that should stay in English may stay unchanged.
Return the complete file as valid JSON with the same structure and nothing before or after it.

texts.video_input mode only, enables the extra: video_input mode only, enables the extraction and use of a separate video file intended for use as a mask. White areas of the extracted video frames will not be affected by diffusion, while black areas will be fully effected. Lighter/darker areas are affected dynamically.
texts.the directory in which your mask video i: the directory in which your mask video is located.
texts.Use a grayscale image as a mask on your: Use a grayscale image as a mask on your init image. Whiter areas of the mask are areas that change more.

texts.Engages hybrid compositing of video into: Engages hybrid compositing of video into animation in various ways with comp alpha as a master mix control.
texts.Initiates extraction of video frames fro: Initiates extraction of video frames from your video_init_path to the inputframes folder. You only need to do this once and then you can change it to False and re-render
texts.Use init image instead of video. Doesn't: Use init image instead of video. Doesn't require generation of inputframes.
texts.Analyzes video frames for camera motion: Analyzes video frames for camera motion and applies movement to render.
texts.Selects the type of Optical Flow to use: Selects the type of Optical Flow to use if Optical Flow is selected in Hybrid motion.
texts.If enabled, changes the behavior or hybr: If enabled, changes the behavior or hybrid_motion to captures motion by comparing the current video frame to the previous rendered image, instead of the previous video frame.
texts.You don't need a mask to composite video: You don't need a mask to composite video. But, Mask types can control the way that video is composited with the previous image each frame.
texts.Equalizes the mask for the composite bef: Equalizes the mask for the composite before or after autocontrast operation (or both)
texts.Auto-contrasts the mask for the composit: Auto-contrasts the mask for the composite. If enabled, uses the low/high autocontrast cutoff schedules.
texts.If this option is selected, many extra f: If this option is selected, many extra frames will be output for the various processes into the hybridframes folder.
texts.Schedule controls how much the composite: Schedule controls how much the composite video is mixed in, whether set to mask is None or using a mask. This is the master mix.
texts.Affects optical flow hybrid motion. 1 is: Affects optical flow hybrid motion. 1 is normal flow. -1 is negative flow. 0.5 is half flow, etc...
texts.If using a blend mask, this controls the: If using a blend mask, this controls the blend amount of the video and render for the composite mask.
texts.Controls the contrast of the composite m: Controls the contrast of the composite mask. 0.5 if half, 1 is normal contrast, 2 is double, etc.
texts.If using autocontrast option, this is th: If using autocontrast option, this is the high cutoff for the operation.
If using autocontrast option, this is the low cutoff for the operation.
texts.This will generate masks of all the huma: This will generate masks of all the humans in a video. Created at generation of hybrid video. Not yet integrated for auto-masking, but it will create the masks, and you can then use the mask video manually.

texts.This option takes twice as long because: This option takes twice as long because it generates twice in order to capture the optical flow from the previous image to the first generation, then warps the previous image and redoes the generation. Works in 2D/3D animation modes.
